explanation: Modal is now a native dialog opened with showModal and closedby any, styled by modal.css with overscroll containment instead of a body overflow lock; Escape and backdrop requests become onClose, with a mouse fallback where closedby is missing. portalHost.ts sends HelpTip and QualityBadge popups into an enclosing dialog; HelpTip, ToolbarPopover and GeneListTools cancel the Escape they handle so the dialog stays open.
